lines.text: This guideline establishes the minimum expectations for offensive and defensive fire attack at structure fires within the jurisdiction.
This guideline applies to all suppression personnel operating at a structure fire incident.
A minimum of two members shall enter the hazard area together and shall remain in voice or visual contact at all times.
A charged hoseline shall be in place before the interior attack team advances past the entry point.
Master streams shall not be directed into a structure while any member is operating inside that structure.
The company officer shall confirm a completed 360-degree size-up before committing the company to an interior attack.
The incident commander shall announce the operational strategy over the assigned tactical channel and shall repeat the announcement on any change of strategy.
Nothing in this guideline relieves any member of the obligation to report an unsafe condition immediately to the incident commander.
